subject: Best way to trace a reactive value

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Best way to trace a reactive value
parts: I'm wondering if anyone knows of a good way to trace a reactive value other than using the react log (`options(shiny.reactlog=TRUE)`),  The react log is cool and it's great for debugging all the moving parts, but sometimes I have one reactive value or one specific observer that I'm not sure why the code entered. So it'd be great to be able to tell exactly what value was invalidated and where it happened.
